data.desc: NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) is developing a dual-use Defense & Security platform combining electronic warfare and defense mobility, laser and photonics engineering, operational-resilience software and AI-assisted orchestration, and advanced manufacturing and support. Its strategy is to integrate operating businesses and developing technologies into solutions for defense, security, critical-infrastructure and industrial customers. NUBURU's operating capabilities include Tekne's special-vehicle and electronic-system engineering, Lyocon's laser expertise and Orbit's operational-resilience software. Integrated mission packages and technologies under development remain subject to validation and applicable approvals.
